rls.phase2_note: The connection role has rolsuper=False but rolbypassrls=True, so row-level security is BYPASSED for this session: enabling RLS today is non-breaking, but none of it is enforceable now. Real enforcement requires a dedicated app_worker role WITHOUT bypassrls plus per-role Admin/Faculty/Student policies on each table BEFORE any app connection switches to that role; enabling RLS with zero policies would deny ALL row access to a non-bypass role.
